main_body: Flat grass ground patch with a repeating tile of small dark and light green tufts; no standing volume.
evidence: The image is a flat grass ground texture. Terrain tiles are not standing objects, so the top/front contract does not apply. There is no standing body, no side faces and no elevation drawing. It reads correctly as a top-down ground surface.

style.evidence: The base is one mid-green flat fill covering large areas, with sparse tufts of dark and light green repeating on a regular grid. The tufts are only 2-3 pixels in size, so most of each 16x16 tile is a single colour (about 3-4 colours per tile). The Beodeul grass reference has dense blade clumps, several greens and soil grain, so the candidate is thinner and flatter. The tiling repeats visibly every 16 px, with the same tufts in the same place on each tile. The dark clumps at the tile edges are blocky.
